name: flow-diagram
title: Flow Diagram
description: A diagram of boxes joined by arrows that the person edits: nodes dragged or moved with the arrow keys, joined by pressing C and choosing the next node (or by pointer), removed with Delete, zoomed and panned; every change said aloud and the whole diagram also given as a list of steps and links.

meta.when: Processes, pipelines and simple node graphs the person builds or rearranges: an approval flow, a data pipeline, a decision tree. For a graph to look at, laid out automatically, use network-graph; for stages with amounts use sankey-chart; for work moving between columns use kanban.
